newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere shares fall against mkt trend.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere shares fall against mkt trend.

text.p: Shares in Lagardere, which had risen sharply since the government selected its bid for Thomson SA over a rival offer from Alcatel Alsthom, weakened on Friday on profit-taking, brokers said.

Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday that Thomson's debt would be 28 billion francs at the end of the year, up from 23.8 billion at the end of 1995. Also, the privatisation has come under political fire, notably for the one-franc sale price.
The stock was down 1.41 percent at 167.60 francs.
Earlier this week it hit a record high of 186 francs, up 32 percent over the share's level prior to winning the bid.

"(The newspaper) La Tribune notes that while defending the agreement, the Minister of Finance has left himself an out, noting the privatisation commission -- which is to give its verdict in mid-December -- can block the deal if it has problems with the deal," a brokerage house said in its daily comment.
